text:
tanya: noticing eu-west1a racks with free GPUs but lots of small pods pending + repeated evictions. looks like transient node NotReady + taints causing fragmentation.

kevin: which racks? any kubelet logs?

tanya: rack-2 and rack-5. events show NodeNotReady then NodeReady within ~6s, but scheduler treats the transient taint and preempts tiny helpers. excerpt: 
```
Normal 05:12:03 kubelet NodeNotReady node/eu-west1a-rack2-03 KubeletNotReady: heartbeat lost
Normal 05:12:06 scheduler FailedScheduling pod=helper-epoch-12 0/24 nodes are available: 24 node(s) had taints that the pod didn't tolerate.
Normal 05:12:10 kubelet NodeReady node/eu-west1a-rack2-03 kubelet is now healthy
```

josh: transient taints + strict affinity = fragmentation. tiny helpers get evicted and leave gaps.

infra-bot: alert: eu-west1 gpu-pending-fragmentation triggered at 2026-02-17T05:12:02Z

kevin: short-term fix: add a tolerate-short-blip annotation for system helper pods so they survive brief NotReady windows. canary to rack-2 only.

josh: medium: scheduler flag to ignore taints younger than Xs for packing-sensitive queues. long: allocator heuristic to prefer warm nodes. also add metrics: transientTaintRate, taintAgeHistogram, fragmentedGPUCount_by_rack.

sre-bot: deploy/provisioner-config v3.2.1 promoted to rack-2 by @kevin at 2026-02-17T05:28Z

tanya: canary applied. monitoring fragmentation and preempt rate. opened infra-7312 with traces and dumps.

josh: cost note: preempts caused spot churn and brief egress spikes; estimated delta ~0.3% over 20m window. add to postmortem.

kevin: followups: 1) canary annotation for helpers, 2) scheduler ignore-young-taints flag behind feature gate, 3) alert when fragmentedGPUCount>8 for >10m.

infra-bot: alert cleared: eu-west1 gpu-pending-fragmentation duration 16m

tanya: watching, looks stable for now. thanks :thumbsup:
